gaps.sentence: Unless you ___ the form by Friday, your application will not be considered.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not' and, like if, takes the present simple: submit.

gaps.sentence: If only I ___ more at university!
gaps.explanation: 'If only + past perfect' — regret about a past failure.

gaps.sentence: He would be healthier if he ___ so much red meat.
gaps.hint: an unreal present habit, past simple
gaps.explanation: For an unreal present habit, the if-clause uses the past simple: did not eat.

gaps.sentence: If the pilot ___ the storm, we would have landed on time.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had avoided.

gaps.sentence: If I had known you were coming, I ___ a cake.
gaps.hint: unreal past result, would have participle
gaps.explanation: The result of an unreal past condition is 'would have' plus the past participle: would have baked.

gaps.sentence: If we ___ a map, we would have arrived hours ago.
gaps.hint: unreal past condition with past perfect
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had brought.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ below five degrees tonight, the event will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses take the present simple even when referring to tonight: drops.

gaps.sentence: If I ___ a million euros, I would travel the world for a year.
gaps.explanation: Second conditionals use the past simple after 'if' for unreal presents: won.
